localReadback.readerObservation: The parser reports the AC1032 source version, an AcDb:Header suffix at byte 844 with expected end 844 and observed end 1583 (739 bytes), and failure at CLASSES. AC1032 is currently a pass-through reader stub; this failure does not adjudicate the suffix layout.

interpretation.whatThisShows: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 completed its conversion of the AC1027 input and produced an AC1032 output file in the selected GUI workflow.
interpretation.whatThisDoesNotShow: The output revision changed, file size changed by eight bytes, and no source-to-output field or byte association was established. ODA acceptance/resave does not explain whether the original suffix is meaningful, preserved, transformed, or discarded.
interpretation.disposition: Keep bytes 844-1575 of the original source classified as unclaimed; retain strict-complete output refusal until producer-backed or normative layout evidence closes the suffix. Do not infer padding or corruption.
